annotation.title_clean: National Artificial Intelligence Research and Development Strategic Plan: 2023 Update
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Research and Development Strategic Plan: 2023 Update
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, National Science and Technology Council (OSTP), United States
annotation.summary_en: The 2023 update of the US federal National AI R&D Strategic Plan retains eight earlier strategies and adds Strategy 9 on international collaboration. It sets federal research priorities on responsible AI, human-AI collaboration, testbeds, standards and benchmarks, workforce, and public-private partnerships. Embodied AI appears only tangentially, as simulation, perception and testing topics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets nine strategies for federal AI R&D, including long-term investment in fundamental and responsible AI research.
Adds new Strategy 9: principled, coordinated international collaboration on AI research.
Calls for expanded federal testbeds, standards and benchmarks to measure and evaluate AI systems.
Supports open-source AI libraries and toolkits through federal investment.
Emphasizes workforce development and public-private partnerships to sustain US AI leadership.
